answer_4.guideline: Edit the dialog when the information present in the dialog is inconsistent with something said (or shared through an image) in earlier or later turns. Remove an image if it is not relevant to the current dialog or the conversation. Replace an image if it does not match the caption that was used to query for images. Edit the dialog to ensure that the details in the conversation are consistent with those given in the event for the session.
